text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Teio Sho. We<n>overhear
spectators discussing<n>Shinko Windy, and their
takes are a<n>mixed bag to say the least.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it's clear that people are paying<n>attention to her.
As for Shinko Windy<n>herself, she's ready for the
race, and<n>determined to silence her detractors<n>once
and for all.
